title: The Virgin Birth
lead: The belief, found in Matthew 1:18–25 and Luke 1:26–38 and confessed in the Apostles' and Nicene Creeds, that Mary conceived Jesus by the Holy Spirit without a human father. (The "Immaculate Conception" is a different teaching, about Mary's own conception.) Matthew links it to Isaiah 7:14, where the Hebrew says "young woman" and the Greek Old Testament "virgin," a text Jews and Christians have long debated.
